name: Bookify – Appointment Booking & Scheduling For Every Thinkable Business
author: Saad Iqbal

sections.description:
Meet Bookify – a business-friendly scheduling system to help appointment booking on WordPress! It helps you get more done, save time, and never forget a thing again.

Bookify makes online booking super easy with Multiple Staff Booking | 10+ integrations | Appointment Notifications | Multiple Payment Gateways | and over 40 other helpful features.

Dive deep into the following useful links to know more about Bookify’s offers:

Documentation | Features | Blog | Go Pro | Get Support

Multi-purpose Appointment Booking Software

Bookify helps you manage full and partial day bookings, set times for meetings, or plan events, all in one smart and easy-to-use appointment booking system on your site.

You can set up staff, manage multiple locations, send automated notifications, and connect with popular tools like Google Calendar, Zoom, and PayPal. Bookify works for solo professionals, teams, and growing businesses that rely on appointments.

Benefits for Your Customers

Your customers can schedule appointments directly from your website; anytime, on any device. They can pick an appointment booking service, choose staff, confirm a time slot, and receive instant email notifications.

Clients can:

– Schedule appointment bookings without contacting your team.
– Use a responsive booking form on desktop or mobile.
– Choose a service, staff member, and location (if applicable).
– View available time slots based on your schedule.
– Enter contact details quickly.
– Receive email confirmations and reminders.

Benefits for Business Owners

Bookify removes the manual work from auto-scheduling. You can manage all your services, staff, and customers from a single dashboard. No coding needed.

You can:

– Add, edit, and track booked appointments in real time.
– Manage staff schedules, breaks, and days off.
– Create and organize services by category.
– View bookings in calendar or list view.
– Search, filter, and export appointments.
– Integrate with Google Calendar, Zoom, and Outlook (Pro).
– Accept secure online payments.

Key Features (Free Version)

– Easy-to-use appointment booking form with shortcode support.
– Unlimited booking forms per site.
– Multi-service and multi-category support.
– Calendar dashboard for a quick overview.
– CSV import/export for customers and services.
– Email notifications for confirmed bookings.
– Translation-ready and mobile-responsive interface.

Bookify Pro Features

Upgrade to Bookify Pro for advanced scheduling and full control.

– Unlimited Staff: Admins can create staff for as many services as possible.
– Geographical Service Locations: Define service areas and allow clients to book appointments based on their preferred location.
– Multiple Slots Booking: Enable clients to book multiple appointments simultaneously.
– Booking in Different Timezone: Accommodate clients in various time zones with flexible scheduling options.
– Stripe Integration: Seamlessly accept online payments through popular payment gateways.
– Calendar integration: Book appointments carefully with the help of popular online calendars like Google and Outlook Calendar.
– Google Meet Integration: Generate unique Google Meet links for each appointment and easily join a video or audio conference at the scheduled time directly through Google Meet.
– Zoom Integration: Bookify lets you connect Zoom with just few clicks. Let your customers book online schedules and appointments by getting an access link via notifications; all within your WordPress dashboard.

Upcoming Features on Bookify

✔ Custom Form Fields
✔ Coupons for offers and discounts
✔ Microsoft Teams
✔ SMS Notification
✔ WhatsApp Notification

Use Cases of Bookify

Bookify fits any business that runs on appointment bookings or client reservations through calendar scheduling.

Online appointment booking and scheduling for:

– Spa and salons
– Health and doctor clinics
– Tutors and schools
– Consultants and legal professionals
– Fitness centers and gyms
– Coaches and mentors
– Restaurants and event planners
– Repair and maintenance services
– Transportation and ticket booking

Whether you’re a freelance business owner or managing a business with multiple staff, Bookify helps you serve customers efficiently.

3rd Party Services

MUI – https://mui.com/material-ui/
ApexCharts – https://apexcharts.com/
FullCalendar – https://fullcalendar.io/

For Developers

The source code for the React application is located in the src folder in the main directory of the plugin, which is structured as follows:

– admin/: Contains all modules for managing the plugin in the WordPress admin dashboard.
– frontend/: Responsible for the main booking forms used by end-users.
– appointment/: Manages the table of booked appointments and related functionality.

Steps to Run the React Application:

1: To Install Dependencies
Open your console, navigate to the plugin directory, and run: npm install
This will install all the required npm packages for the React application.

2: Run in Development Mode
To build and run the React app in development mode, execute: npm run start
This will launch a development server with hot reloading for React.

3: Build for Production
If you’re preparing the plugin for production, run: npm run build
This command will generate an optimized, production-ready build of the React app.
sections.faq:
Can I use Bookify for more than one business type?

Yes, Bookify is designed to help all the business types one can imagine. This multi-purpose appointment booking tool makes it feasible and unique for businesses like spa & salons, gyms, medical wellness centers, legal practices, and more.

Can I integrate Bookify with payment gateways and calendar scheduling services?

Yes, Bookify is integrated with multiple gateways like Stripe and PayPal and calendar syncing with Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar.

How many appointment bookings can I add with Bookify?

Bookify enables you to add unlimited appointment bookings and meetings to support your business needs.

Can I mark any day special in Bookify?

Yes! Bookify lets you do special day scheduling to manage peak hours or special day events. For example, you can keep one Saturday ON if you usually keep your business off on Saturdays.

Can I assign different staff members to manage multiple bookings?

Yes, Bookify allows multiple staff with specified roles for flexible and personnel-specific appointment booking management experience.

Can I create forms in Bookify?

Currently, no. But our development team is working tirelessly to enable Bookify to create forms directly and to offer integration with other appointment booking form builders.

Can I create/book multiple slots in a day?

Yes, Bookify helps you book multiple slots for multiple staff in a day which makes Bookify a unique appointment booking calendar scheduling tool.

Can I send reminder to clients regarding their upcoming booking?

Yes, you can send a reminder email to clients to nudge them about their upcoming appointment booking.

Is the Bookify Free version 100% free, or any strings attach to that?

Yes, Bookify is a free WordPress appointment booking system (available on WordPress.org) with no strings attach to that. However, we have developed Bookify Pro version that offers additional superior features.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team helps validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.
